sources.title: DeepSeek-V3.1 official model card
sources.evidence: Names exact V3.1, its V3.1-Base lineage and unchanged V3 model structure; advertises 671B main-model parameters, 37B activated, 128K context, text chat, thinking/non-thinking modes, non-thinking tool calls plus a special thinking-mode search-tool format, public weights and MIT licensing.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V3.1 checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: DeepseekV3ForCausalLM with 61 main layers, one next-token-prediction layer, first 3 dense layers, 256 routed and 1 shared expert, 8 selected experts/token, MLA dimensions, untied main embeddings, FP8 E4M3 with 128x128 blocks/UE8M0 scales; max_position_embeddings=163840.

sources.title: DeepSeek API change log: 2025-08-21 DeepSeek-V3.1
sources.evidence: Dated entry explicitly announces V3.1 on 2025-08-21, with thinking/non-thinking modes and enhanced tool/agent use. Later entries show these API aliases have subsequently moved to other models; this audit concerns the V3.1 checkpoint.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V3 weight structure and FP8 documentation
sources.evidence: V3.1 card explicitly states the same model structure. This first-party weight documentation separates 671B main weights from MTP; MTP shares the main embedding and output-head matrices. weight_scale_inv tensors are FP8 dequantization scales, not additional model parameters. Its rounded MTP/active figures are not substituted for the V3.1 header count.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V3.1 pinned tensor index and all indexed safetensors headers
sources.evidence: Read only 8-byte header lengths and bounded JSON header ranges for all 163 indexed shards: 91,991 tensors, 11,888,393 header bytes including prefixes, zero weight payload. Index/header names matched completely. Main: 671,067,257,432 stored elements less 40,838,232 scales = 671,026,419,200 parameter entries. MTP: 13,464,128,568 stored elements less 702,264 scales = 13,463,426,304 parameter entries. Two documented shared matrices, each 129280x7168, contribute 1,853,358,080 copied entries. Excluding these gives 11,610,068,224 MTP entries, but whether its additional 7168-element shared_head.norm is tied to main.norm was not resolved. Conditional full unique totals are 682,636,480,256 to 682,636,487,424; neither is adopted as verified. The guide's nominal 11.5B unique MTP differs from this approximately 11.610B derivation.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V3.1 official model implementation
sources.evidence: Defines Transformer decoder layers and causal language model; routing e_score_correction_bias is nn.Parameter. The 59 such 256-element tensors are retained in the count; only weight_scale_inv tensors are excluded as quantization metadata.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V3.1 MIT License
sources.evidence: Repository license is MIT; exact V3.1 model card explicitly applies it to model weights as well.

name.note: Exact released checkpoint name, distinct from V3.1-Base and V3.1-Terminus.

family.note: Catalog family key is consistent with the explicitly documented DeepSeek-V3 lineage.

release_date.note: Explicit dated first-party release entry; day precision confirmed.

open_weights.note: Public official checkpoint and complete indexed safetensors headers accessed.

license.note: MIT applies explicitly to repository and model weights.

parameters_b.note: Complete unique learned count:671.0264192B main +11.610068224B unique MTP =682.636487424B. All163 pinned headers reconciled; FP8 scales excluded and documented shared embedding/head counted once. Exact small tensor comparison establishes distinct MTP norm. The guide nominal11.5B MTP differs from the exact11.610068224B count;671B is nominal main-only.

active_parameters_b.note: Exact V3.1 card reports nominal 37B activated per token for the main model; this is not an exact count or a combined main-plus-MTP speculative-decoding count.

architecture.note: Decoder-only Transformer with MLA and DeepSeekMoE: 61 main layers, first 3 dense, then 256 routed experts/top-8 plus a shared expert; one additional MTP module.

context_window.note: Advertised128K context represented as nominal128000 consistently with the other V3 and R1 releases. Configured163840 positions are a separate ceiling, not a replacement for documented support.

modalities.note: Official text-token chat templates and causal-LM implementation; no vision/audio encoder or corresponding modality interface in this checkpoint.

reasoning.note: One checkpoint supports thinking and non-thinking modes through its chat template.

tool_call.note: General tool calling is documented for non-thinking mode; a separate format supports search tools in thinking mode.

description.value: Hybrid-reasoning DeepSeek model with thinking and non-thinking modes
description.note: Baseline description is directly supported and introduces no unsupported performance claim.

patch.notes: Complete count: 671.0264192B main + 11.610068224B unique MTP; shared embedding/head counted once and FP8 scales excluded. The MTP norm differs from the main norm. Nominal 37B active applies to the main model. Advertised context is 128K; config positions are 163840. General tool calls use non-thinking mode; thinking has a separate search-tool format.
